title: "Historical SAMHSA Treatment Facility Data"
description: "Address-level historical treatment facility listings reconstructed from SAMHSA directories."
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

This project reconstructs address-level treatment facility listings from 26 SAMHSA directories: 1998, 2000, 2001, and 2003-2025. PDF directories through 2021 are converted to a common format aligned with SAMHSA's 2022-2025 workbooks. Directory and survey years are retained.

**Version 1.1.1**

[Explore dashboard](../treatment-facilities-dashboard/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/studhall/samhsa-treatment-facility-directories){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Download

The combined files contain all 26 directories through 2025, representing survey years through 2024. Choose the format you normally use; each file contains the same facility-year records.

| Facility-year data | Link |
|---|---|
| CSV.gz | [Download](https://github.com/studhall/samhsa-treatment-facility-directories/releases/download/v1.1.1/facilities.csv.gz) |
| RDS | [Download](https://github.com/studhall/samhsa-treatment-facility-directories/releases/download/v1.1.1/facilities.rds) |
| Stata (.dta) | [Download](https://github.com/studhall/samhsa-treatment-facility-directories/releases/download/v1.1.1/facilities.dta) |
| Parquet | [Download](https://github.com/studhall/samhsa-treatment-facility-directories/releases/download/v1.1.1/facilities.parquet) |

These are historical records, not a current treatment locator. Historical phone numbers are included in research downloads and may be stale.

<details class="data-details">
<summary>Limitations</summary>

Quality assurance is ongoing. Manual gold-sample review of the PDF years is incomplete. The 2022-2025 spreadsheet directories have passed checksum and structural checks but have not received the same record-level review. In the official 2025 workbook, 556 U.S. listings omit a street address while retaining city, state, and ZIP; these records remain included and flagged. County geography is preliminary; most assignments currently use a ZIP-to-county fallback. Missing characteristics mean that a question was not asked or cannot be harmonized, not that no facility offered the service. Pre-2021 N-SSATS and post-2020 N-SUMHSS data are not directly trend-comparable.

</details>
